sql.query: INSERT INTO tbl_contract_document_clauses (tenantId,contractId,sourceClauseId,clauseHeading,clauseTextSnapshot,clauseBehaviour,conditionKey,displayOrder,isIncluded,isCustom,createdByUserId,modifiedByUserId) SELECT gc.tenantId,gc.id,c.id,COALESCE(c.clauseName,NULLIF(TRIM(:heading),'')),COALESCE(c.clauseHtml,NULLIF(TRIM(:clauseText),'')),COALESCE(c.clauseBehaviour,CASE WHEN :behaviour IN ('mandatory','optional','conditional') THEN :behaviour2 ELSE 'optional' END),c.conditionKey,COALESCE((SELECT MAX(x.displayOrder)+10 FROM tbl_contract_document_clauses x WHERE x.tenantId=gc.tenantId AND x.contractId=gc.id),10),1,CASE WHEN c.id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,:userId,:userId2 FROM tbl_generated_contracts gc LEFT JOIN tbl_contract_clauses c ON c.id=NULLIF(:sourceClauseId,0) AND c.tenantId=gc.tenantId AND c.isActive=1 WHERE gc.id=:contractId AND gc.tenantId=:tenantId AND gc.status='draft' AND (c.id IS NOT NULL OR (NULLIF(TRIM(:heading2),'') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(:text2),'') IS NOT NULL)) AND (c.id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_contract_document_clauses existing WHERE existing.tenantId=gc.tenantId AND existing.contractId=gc.id AND existing.sourceClauseId=c.id)) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_roles r ON r.id=utr.roleId AND r.isActive=1 INNER JOIN tbl_role_permissions rp ON rp.roleId=r.id INNER JOIN tbl_permissions p ON p.id=rp.permissionId AND p.permissionCode='agreements.drafts.edit' AND p.isActive=1 WHERE utr.userId=:roleUser AND utr.tenantId=gc.tenantId AND utr.isActive=1)
